name: Hara Hara Fiancee ~Anata o Soudatsu! Hime-sama to Onee-chan no Kainin Race!!~
original_name: はらはらフィアンセ～貴方を争奪！姫様とお姉ちゃんの懐妊レース!!～
source:
Yukiya is a university student. One day, a girl called Eleonora suddenly appears in front of him and tells him that she will marry him. It seems she is princess and comes from a different world. According to her, she will need to have his baby to show her attractiveness. He doesn't know what to do, but she approaches him. However, Kotono, his old friend, takes part in it as well.

[From [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20090318153909/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/products_id/1010657]ErogeShop.com[/url]]
translation:
雪也原本是一名大学生。一天，一名叫艾蕾奥诺拉的少女突然出现在他面前，声称要嫁给他。她似乎是来自异世界的公主。据她所说，为了证明自己的魅力，她必须怀上雪也的孩子。雪也不知所措，她却主动接近了他。然而，雪也的青梅竹马琴乃也加入了这场争夺。

[摘自[url=http://web.archive.org/web/20090318153909/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/products_id/1010657]ErogeShop.com[/url]]
